scope: Unapplied source-only redundant active input zero-store removal. Public and matched-owner patches are alternatives for their respective source copies, not two changes to one linked object.
value_equality: For capacity C, active count R and row stride S, the validated domain is0<R<=C. Each unchanged memcpy copies exactly4*R*S bytes from the complete input span.
Original final staging words are: word0unchanged; rows[0,R)exact input bytes;rows[R,C)zero; program suffixunchanged. New staging words have exactly those same values.
The new fill begins at word1+R*S and writes(C-R)*S zero words. Its end is word1+C*S, immediately before the existing canonical program. AtR=C the valid fill range is empty.
No active field or limb is removed: the complete original memcpy remains byte-for-byte; only its immediately overwritten preceding zero stores are omitted.
All7 ordinary stage entrypoints validate size<=capacity before the range. EndpointAndDense validates max(endpoints.size,dense.size)<=capacity, establishing both independent subtractions.

Stage::input is private storage. The existing serialized owning dispatcher and synchronous staging/write call expose no observer between fill and memcpy. No caller input aliases that owned private vector in the supported API.

First full program uploads, later active-prefix uploads, inactive-input zeroing, fixed capacity header/program suffix, all validators/readback checks, all40fields/4columns/7RHS/3trials/4quartics and recovery/rollback/rounding/FP/counts/governors are unchanged.
representation_spacing_patch: Unchanged, independent and nonoverlapping; no nextafter/IsRepresented rewrite included.
limits: No bottleneck/global-GPU attribution or speedup claim follows from the one-dispatcher samples. N was rejected at its performance gate and no N frame ran; all-thread evidence must accompany a later changed candidate's required frame if its preceding gates pass. No actual source modification, host build/link/test or runtime was performed.
